newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 22.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 22.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average recovered to close 16.26 points higher at 7,906.72.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index gained 21.12 points, or 2.11 percent, to 1,022.67.
* Ringgit remains volatile, quoted at 2.6220/50 a dollar at around 0100 GMT, sharply down from earlier high of 2.6360.
* Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad returns from two-month work-and-rest break.
* Strong assertions from leaders and economists about Malaysian economy's strong health expected to continue boosting stocks, dealers say.
* "Share prices should be up today partly because Mahathir is returning and partly because local funds are expected to continue their support," said a dealer at a local brokerage.
* Dealers said bargain-hunting was also expected to bring back several foreign investors.
